basic_info.description: This spacious home is ready for its next owner! On a clear day, the Pacific Ocean, Downtown San Francisco, and the Golden Gate Bridge are all visible from the front rooms of the house.    The top level boasts a primary suite with a walk-in closet and an additional closet, a private bathroom, and a spacious bedroom overlooking the beautifully landscaped backyard. Two other bedrooms, one with an attached sunroom, complete this level. Multiple skylights ensure this level is wonderfully bright.    The main level is an entertainer's dream, featuring a huge living room with vaulted ceilings and a fireplace, a formal dining room, a dedicated home office, and an eat-in kitchen that opens to a family room. A convenient powder room and another sunroom leading to the flat backyard complete this level.    The lower level features a large foyer, interior access to the two-car garage, a versatile space suitable for an exercise room or a massive mudroom, a laundry room, and ample storage.
